basics.name: Gabriel Favot
basics.label: Fullstack Engineer
basics.summary: Fullstack engineer, 7 years shipping production software in startups: 3 years on a B2B online bank, owning client projects end to end, then 3 years on a multi-tenant SaaS platform sold to CAC 40 accounts. Architecture, deployments and releases, from scoping the need to production.

work.name: Beamy
work.summary: SaaS Governance platform sold to CAC 40 accounts — a single 8-person engineering team, with no dedicated frontend or DevOps team.
highlights: Fullstack development (NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Nuxt 3) on a multi-tenant, multi-database architecture spread across 6 interconnected repositories, at the level of rigor large accounts require.
Browser extension deployed to 100,000+ users across client organisations: feature development and release rollouts in production.
Owned the team's deployments and releases — one delivery every two weeks, from preparation to production on GCP and Kubernetes — then a broader cross-functional role covering data.
Applied Hexagonal Architecture across several projects to decouple domain from infrastructure and keep the code testable, in a team built around clean code and code review.
Brought AI into the company in 2022 with GitHub Copilot, then drove adoption across the team through to agentic development tools.

work.name: Manager.one
work.position: PHP Backend Engineer, then Technical Project Lead
work.summary: B2B online bank for professionals, a Qonto competitor (~40 people) — a 9-person backend team carrying every feature and every client project.
highlights: Two white-label platforms delivered end to end (La Nef, BWF): requirements gathering with the client, estimation, dispatch to the teams, technical decisions and follow-through to production.
BWF, the most demanding project of the role: adapting a banking product designed for B2B to the core banking constraints of a B2C client.
Backend development on the core platform (PHP / Yii 2, SQL Server): banking features, integrations and maintenance.
Led a team of 3 developers: onboarding a junior, code reviews and spreading best practices.

work.name: Air France
work.summary: Frontend development on an internal flight-planning tool (Angular, TypeScript): reusable UI components and REST API integration, in a small agile team.

projects.name: Tech watch & side projects
projects.description: Dedicated time for keeping up and building, continuing the AI tooling adoption started at Beamy.
highlights: Daily development with agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Cursor): spec first, every diff reviewed.

Small projects to get hands-on with new tech: a job-listing scraper (LinkedIn, Welcome to the Jungle), homegrown AI agents, a connected dashcam that counts the Clios it passes each day, and sound.gab.pm (Nuxt 3 + Spotify API).

projects.name: Home server & homelab
highlights: Home server on a mini-PC (Proxmox) hosting around fifteen open-source services and custom micro-apps via Docker, including https://cv.gab.pm.
Home Assistant for home automation, network configuration, plus maintenance and version upgrades across the stack.

projects.name: Apartment full renovation
projects.description: Complete renovation of an apartment done solo (flooring, plumbing, electrics, painting, kitchen, bathroom), an entirely new field, from design through to renting it out.
